p: comely for the upright: It is the duty of the godly to set forth the praises of God for his mercy and power showed to them.
instrument of ten strings: To sing on instruments, was a part of the ceremonial service of the temple, which does not belong to us any more than the sacrifices, censors and light.
word of the LORD is right: That is, counsel or command in governing the world.
works are done in truth: That is, the effect and execution.
loveth righteousness and judgment: However the world judges God's works, yet he does all things according to justice and mercy.
gathereth the waters of the sea: By the creation of the heavens and beautiful ornament with the gathering also of the waters, he sets forth the power of God, that all creatures might fear him.
counsel of the heathen to nought: No counsel can prevail against God, but he deserves it, and it will have evil success.
God is the LORD: He shows that all our happiness stands in this, that the Lord is our God.
looketh from heaven: He proves that all things are governed by God's providence and not by fortune.
fashioneth their hearts alike: Therefore he knows their wicked enterprises.
king saved by the multitude of: If kings and the mighty of the world cannot be saved by worldly means, but only by God's providence, what do others have to trust in, who have not similar means?
the eye of the LORD is: God shows his mercy toward his, which man by no means is able to compass.
Our soul waiteth for the LORD: Thus he speaks in the name of the whole Church which only depends on God's providence.
